title: Design: Work Orders settings with Internal Work Orders on show two hint lines
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have at least one customer flagged as Internal customer.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow0-03-02-settings-setting-on.png, iwo-happy-03-03-setting-on.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Internal Work Orders toggle is on, with its description under the name.
  • Two grey hint lines sit under the description, each led by an info icon: "Manage categories in Internal Work Orders (Administration > Service). Their expense accounts are set on each category." with "Internal Work Orders" as a blue link, and "Map their expense accounts in Integrations > QuickBooks." with the QuickBooks mark and "QuickBooks" as a blue link.
  • Each hint stays on one line beside its icon.

Step 2:

  • Nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off, and every label stays on its line as in the 1440 pixel view.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R3: “While the toggle is on, two hint lines sit under the description, each with an info icon: "Manage categories in Internal Work Orders (Administration > Service). Their expense accounts are set on each category." where Internal Work Orders is a link to the categories page (S1-R13), and "Map their expense accounts in Integrations > QuickBooks." with the QuickBooks mark, where QuickBooks is a link (shown only when QuickBooks is connected at any location; for AccountingHub the hint names Accounting > Account Mappings; with both, the hint names both; with neither, the second line is omitted).”
